planSteps.description: Navigate to / and scroll until the element with data-testid 'hero-demo' is in view
Wait up to 30 seconds for the button data-testid 'demo-play' to become enabled
The hero demo shows the text 'Maine 2018, U.S. House District 2'
Wait up to 15 seconds without clicking anything, until data-testid 'demo-round' reads 'Round 2 / 2'
Without clicking, scrolling or pressing any key, wait 2 seconds and read data-testid 'demo-round' again; repeat 6 times (12 seconds total), recording each reading
All 6 readings of data-testid 'demo-round' are exactly 'Round 2 / 2'; none of them is 'Round 1 / 2' (the replay must hold on the final round, not loop back)
data-testid 'demo-outcome' reads exactly 'Golden, Jared F.' and data-testid 'demo-certified' shows 'Matches the certified result'
